A reception will follow in the foyer, where you may meet colleagues and students over refreshments. Kindly reply to graduation@university.edu.cn before June 15th so that seats can be reserved for you.

Your presence would be an honour we greatly value.

Yours faithfully,
Li Ming
model.zh:
尊敬的先生/女士：

我代表我校毕业典礼委员会写信邀请您出席今年的毕业典礼，我们相信有您的到场，典礼将更加令人难忘。

典礼定于6月22日（星期六）上午9:00在主校区大礼堂举行，历时约两小时，届时校长将授予学位，优秀毕业生将分享感想。典礼后将在门厅举行招待会，您可以边用茶点边与同事和学生交流。请于6月15日前回复 graduation@university.edu.cn，以便我们为您预留座位。

您的出席是我们十分珍视的荣幸。

您忠实的，
Li Ming

years.directionsEn: Suppose you are working for the "Aiding Rural Primary Schools" project of your university. Write an email to answer the inquiring from an international student volunteer. Specify the details of the project. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in the e-mail. Use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
years.tip: 回信（答复咨询）。逐条回答对方的问题，细节要充分；回信要呼应来信的问法。
years.note: 本题为「答复咨询的回信」，按题型清单归入咨询信。

model.en:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your interest in our "Aiding Rural Primary Schools" project. I am glad to answer your inquiry in detail.

The project centres on improving English teaching in rural primary schools. From July 8th to August 2nd, volunteers will live on the school campus in Qinghe County, teaching four morning classes daily and organizing afternoon activities such as reading clubs, painting and sports. As for qualifications, volunteers are expected to be patient, cooperative and fluent in English; a brief online interview and a two-day training session are required. Accommodation and meals are provided free of charge, and a round-trip travel allowance is offered.

Should you have further questions, please write to me.

Yours faithfully,
Li Ming
model.zh:
尊敬的先生/女士：

感谢您对我校“援助农村小学”项目的关注，我很乐意详细答复您的咨询。

该项目以提升农村小学英语教学为核心。7月8日至8月2日期间，志愿者将住在清河县的学校校内，每天上午上四节课，下午组织阅读俱乐部、绘画、体育等活动。关于条件，志愿者需耐心、善于合作且英语流利，还须通过一次简短的线上面试并参加为期两天的培训。食宿免费提供，另发放往返交通补贴。

如您还有其他问题，请给我写信。

您忠实的，
Li Ming

model.en:

The Students' Union is pleased to announce a singing contest to be held for all international students, and your participation would be warmly welcomed.

The contest will take place in the University Hall from 7:00 to 9:30 p.m. on May 15th. years.directionsEn: A foreign friend of yours has recently graduated from college and intends to find a job in China. Write him/her an email to make some suggestions. You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end. Use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
years.tip: 建议信（给求职的外国朋友）。建议要落地：语言、简历、行业选择、面试准备。

model.en:
Dear friend,

Delighted to learn that you have graduated and intend to seek employment in China, I am writing to offer a few practical suggestions.

To begin with, update your resume in both Chinese and English, highlighting any internship or volunteer experience relevant to the position. It is also advisable to register with reputable recruitment websites such as 51job and to follow target companies on their official WeChat accounts. Moreover, since many interviews are conducted in Chinese, polishing your spoken Chinese and preparing a concise self-introduction will give you a distinct advantage. Finally, do check whether your visa permits full-time work.

Please let me know if I can be of further help. I wish you every success.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
model.zh:
亲爱的朋友：

得知你已毕业并打算在中国求职，我很高兴，特此写信给你一些实用建议。

首先，请更新中英文简历，突出与岗位相关的实习或志愿经历。也建议你在 51job 等正规招聘网站注册，并关注目标企业的微信公众号。此外，由于许多面试用中文进行，提高中文口语并准备一段简短的自我介绍会让你更具优势。最后，务必确认你的签证是否允许全职工作。

如还需帮助请告诉我。祝你一切顺利。

你诚挚的，
Li Ming

years.directionsEn: Write an email to a professor at a British university, inviting him/her to organize a team for the international innovation to be held at your university. You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. (10 points)

years.note: 两个独立来源（新东方网「网友回忆版」、新东方在线）的英文题面完全一致（international innovation）。另有汇总类网页（kyzs.com）把 2022 年小作文写成「邀请外教担任英语演讲比赛的评委」，但该来源自身的 2013 年条目与之文字重复，判断为汇总页串行/错位，未采信。

model.en:
Dear Professor,

On behalf of the Organizing Committee of our university, I am writing to invite you to organize a team for the International Innovation Competition to be held on our campus this autumn.

The competition aims to encourage students to turn creative ideas into practical solutions, and teams from over thirty universities are expected to take part. As a scholar with wide experience in mentoring young innovators, you would be ideally placed to select and guide a team of five from your own university. We would cover all travel and accommodation expenses, and the deadline for confirmation is June 30th. Detailed rules are attached for your reference.

We sincerely hope you will accept our invitation.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
model.zh:
尊敬的教授：

我代表我校组委会写信，邀请您为今年秋季在我校举办的国际创新大赛组建一支参赛团队。

该赛事旨在鼓励学生把创意转化为可行方案，预计有三十多所高校的队伍参加。作为在指导青年创新者方面经验丰富的学者，您非常适合从贵校挑选并带领一支五人团队。我们将承担全部交通与住宿费用，确认参赛的截止日期为6月30日。详细规则见附件，供您参考。

Li Ming

model.en:
NOTICE

Prof. Smith's research project on campus sports activities requires one student assistant, and applications are now invited from all students.

The assistant will collect and organize data on students' weekly exercise habits, distribute and retrieve questionnaires, and help prepare short reports for the project group. Applicants should be second- or third-year students who can devote about six hours a week, and familiarity with Excel or SPSS is preferred. A good command of written English would be an advantage.

Those interested should send a brief resume to sportsproject@university.edu.cn before October 20th, and shortlisted candidates will be interviewed the following week.

Office of the Research Project
Li Ming

史密斯教授关于校园体育活动的研究项目现需一名学生助理，面向全体学生招募。

该助理将收集并整理学生每周锻炼习惯的数据，发放和回收问卷，并协助撰写项目组的简要报告。申请者应为二、三年级学生，每周能投入约六小时，熟悉 Excel 或 SPSS 者优先，有较好的英语书面表达能力者更佳。

years.recipient: 留学生同学 Paul（发来求助邮件的国际学生）
years.taskZh: 阅读留学生 Paul 的来信并写回信：Paul 有一项课堂作业，要做关于一位中国古代科学家的口头报告，不知如何准备，向你求助；你需在约100词的回信中给出建议。
points: 阅读来信并回信给留学生 Paul
就如何准备「关于中国古代科学家的口头报告」提出建议
years.directionsEn: Read the following email from an international student and write a reply. — Dear Li Ming, I've got a class assignment to make an oral report on an ancient Chinese scientist, but I'm not sure how to prepare for it. Can you give me some advice? Thank you for your help. Yours, Paul — Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in your email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
years.tip: 读信 + 回信建议。先回应对方的处境，再给具体建议，语气要体贴。
years.note: 本题形式为「读信＋回信并提建议」，按题型清单归入建议信。

model.en:
Dear Paul,

It is a pleasure to hear from you. Preparing an oral report on an ancient Chinese scientist is easier if you approach it step by step.

First, choose a figure with a clear legacy, such as Zhang Heng, who invented the seismograph. Then read two or three reliable sources and note down his life, major achievements and their influence. Rather than reciting facts, build your report around one question: why did his inventions matter to ordinary people? A simple timeline or a picture of his device will make your slides more engaging. Finally, rehearse aloud twice, and be ready to answer one or two questions. I would be glad to listen to your draft and offer feedback.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
model.zh:
亲爱的 Paul：

很高兴收到你的来信。只要按步骤推进，准备关于中国古代科学家的口头报告并不难。

首先，选一位成就明确的科学家，比如发明地动仪的张衡。然后阅读两三份可靠资料，记下他的生平、主要成就及其影响。不要只是罗列事实，而应围绕一个问题展开报告，例如他的发明为何对普通人重要。一张简单的时间轴或他发明的器物图片会让幻灯片更吸引人。最后，朗读练习两遍，并准备好回答一两个问题。我很乐意听你的初稿并给出反馈。

你诚挚的，
Li Ming
outline: Dear Paul 称呼加逗号，首句回应来信并表明愿意提供建议
用 First/Then 分步骤建议：选定人物、查阅可靠资料并做笔记
用 Rather than reciting 引出以问题为主线，并提示配图表
最后建议限时演练，末句表示乐于看稿反馈，Yours sincerely 落款

years.recipient: 同学 Paul（发来邮件的同学）
years.taskZh: 阅读同学 Paul 的来信并回信：他得知你将邀请年轻手工艺人在校园展示创新工艺制作，想知道他们展示什么，也表示愿帮忙做准备；你在约100词回信中回答这两点。

说明 Paul 可以做哪些准备工作（what I can do）
years.directionsEn: Read the following email from your classmate Paul and write him a reply. — Dear Li Ming, I was really excited to hear that you'd invite some young craftsmen to demonstrate their innovative craft-making on campus. May I know more about what they'll show? Also, I'd like to help with your preparation work. Please let me know what I can do. Yours, Paul — Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in the email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
years.tip: 回信（答复同学来信的两点）。逐点回应，结构清晰是首要评分点。
years.note: 题型为「回信」（答复同学来信并回答其所问两点），不属于题型清单中的固定书信类型，故归入「其他」。

model.en:
Dear Paul,

Thank you for your enthusiasm. I am glad to tell you what the young craftsmen will present.

They will demonstrate how traditional skills can be renewed. Among them are a bamboo weaver who combines old weaving patterns with modern lighting design, a potter using recycled clay, and a paper-cut artist creating animated short films. Visitors may try these crafts themselves at hands-on tables.

As for your help, you could design a poster and circulate it through the campus WeChat groups, and reserve the exhibition hall and six long tables for the afternoon of June 10th. Your presence during the setting-up would also be a great support. Let me know what suits you.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
model.zh:
亲爱的 Paul：

谢谢你的热情。我很高兴告诉你这些年轻手工艺人将展示什么。

他们将展示传统技艺如何焕发新意。其中有把古老编织纹样与现代灯具设计结合的竹编艺人，有使用再生陶土的陶艺师，还有创作动画短片的剪纸艺术家。参观者可以在体验台上亲手尝试这些手艺。

至于你的帮忙，你可以设计一张海报并在校园微信群里转发，同时预订6月10日下午的展厅和六张长桌。布置场地时你能到场也是很大的支持。告诉我你方便的安排。

你诚挚的，
Li Ming
outline: 首句回应 Paul 的热情，说明将回答他提出的两个问题
用 Among them are 倒装句举例说明手工艺人的具体展示内容
用 As for your help 分派海报宣传与场地预订两项准备任务
补充到场支持并请对方回复，Yours sincerely 落款署 Li Ming

notes: 格式分不能丢：英语一统一署名 Li Ming（通知类用组织名，如 the Postgraduate Association / the Students' Union）。署名后不要加点；书信称呼后用逗号；通知要居中大写标题 NOTICE，落款写组织与日期。
近年趋势是「读信 + 回信」：2019、2024、2025 都要求先读懂来信内容再逐条回应。答题时把对方的问题逐点对应回答，比堆砌套话更容易得分。
字数控制：约 100 词，正文 7—9 句足够。宁可少而准，不要为了凑字数写与要点无关的句子。
